quests.description: Which object here would confuse people 100 years from now?

id.title: Arkeolog masa depan
id.description: Barang apa di sini yang bakal bikin bingung orang 100 tahun lagi?

quests.title: Upside-down view
quests.description: Bend over and look at the room upside down.

id.title: Pandangan terbalik
id.description: Bungkuk dan lihat ruangan dari posisi terbalik.

quests.title: Shades of blue
quests.description: How many different blues can you spot right now?

id.title: Ragam biru
id.description: Berapa macam warna biru yang bisa kamu lihat sekarang?

quests.title: Bug safari
quests.description: Look for any tiny bug, inside or out. What is it?

id.title: Safari serangga
id.description: Cari serangga kecil, di dalam atau luar. Serangga apa?

quests.title: Animal watch
quests.description: Spot any animal today and watch what it's doing.

id.title: Pengamat hewan
id.description: Temukan hewan apa aja hari ini dan lihat lagi ngapain.

quests.title: Plate game
quests.description: Find a number plate with a number that adds up to ten.

id.title: Main pelat nomor
id.description: Cari pelat nomor yang angkanya kalau dijumlah jadi sepuluh.

quests.description: On your next walk, take one turn you've never taken.

id.title: Jalan baru
id.description: Di jalan kaki berikutnya, ambil satu belokan yang belum pernah kamu lewati.

quests.title: Room sounds
quests.description: Tap different surfaces gently. Which one sounds the best?

id.title: Bunyi ruangan
id.description: Ketuk pelan berbagai permukaan. Mana yang bunyinya paling enak?

quests.title: Cloud race
quests.description: Pick two clouds. Which one moves faster?

id.title: Balapan awan
id.description: Pilih dua awan. Mana yang geraknya lebih cepat?

quests.title: Dream getaway
quests.description: Where would you go this weekend if you could go anywhere?

id.title: Kabur akhir pekan
id.description: Kalau bisa ke mana aja akhir pekan ini, kamu pilih ke mana?

quests.title: Color roulette
quests.description: Spin for a color, then find three things in it.

id.title: Warna acak
id.description: Putar buat dapet warna, terus cari tiga barang warna itu.

quests.title: Trip ranking
quests.description: Rank these trips from dream trip to maybe later.

id.title: Peringkat liburan
id.description: Urutkan liburan ini dari yang paling diimpikan.

quests.title: Octopus hearts
quests.description: How many hearts does an octopus have?

interaction.explain: Three! Two pump blood through the gills, one through the body.

id.title: Jantung gurita
id.description: Gurita punya berapa jantung?
id.explain: Tiga! Dua memompa darah ke insang, satu ke seluruh tubuh.

quests.title: Forever food
quests.description: Which food can last for a very, very long time if stored well?

interaction.explain: Honey! Sealed honey can stay edible for years and years.

id.title: Makanan awet
id.description: Makanan apa yang bisa awet lama banget kalau disimpan dengan baik?
id.explain: Madu! Madu yang tertutup rapat bisa awet bertahun-tahun.

quests.title: Banana mystery
quests.description: What does a banana grow on?

interaction.explain: Banana plants look like trees, but they are giant herbs with no wood.

id.title: Misteri pisang
id.description: Pisang tumbuh di mana?
id.explain: Pisang kelihatan kayak pohon, tapi sebenarnya tanaman herba raksasa tanpa batang kayu.

quests.title: Sloth life
quests.description: What do sloths spend most of their day doing?

interaction.explain: Sloths rest for most of the day. Relatable.

id.title: Hidup si sloth
id.description: Sloth paling banyak ngapain seharian?
id.explain: Sloth kebanyakan santai seharian. Relate banget.

quests.title: Speed of sunlight
quests.description: How long does sunlight take to reach Earth?

interaction.explain: About 8 minutes. The sunlight you see left the sun a little while ago!

id.title: Kecepatan cahaya matahari
id.description: Cahaya matahari butuh berapa lama buat sampai ke Bumi?
id.explain: Sekitar 8 menit. Cahaya yang kamu lihat udah berangkat dari matahari beberapa menit lalu!

quests.title: Pink mystery
quests.description: Why are flamingos pink?

interaction.explain: Their food, like tiny shrimp, has pink pigments. Chicks are born grey!

id.title: Misteri pink
id.description: Kenapa flamingo warnanya pink?
id.explain: Makanannya, kayak udang kecil, punya pigmen pink. Anak flamingo lahirnya abu-abu!
